title: A process alternates CPU and I/O bursts
purpose: Show alternating execution and I/O waiting phases.
alt: 프로세스가 CPU 연산과 I/O 대기 구간을 번갈아 수행하는 실행 순서
requiredChecks: CPU burst and I/O burst alternate in sequence at least three times.
CPU bursts execute instructions; I/O bursts wait for I/O completion.
Read/write requests occur on CPU side before waiting; no CPU execution during wait.
Schematic sequence has no invented time values or parallel execution.
prompt: Create an ORIGINAL English raster technical figure for an IT reference blog. Opaque white background, navy highly readable type, restrained blue/teal/amber, flat design, generous margins. Exact data and labels only, no logos/copying textbook composition. Title 'A process alternates CPU and I/O bursts'. Vertical timeline of six large alternating cards: CPU burst 'Execute instructions; issue I/O request', I/O burst 'Wait for I/O completion', CPU burst same, I/O burst same, CPU burst same, I/O burst same. Downward arrows show temporal order, ellipses top/bottom. Blue CPU, teal I/O. Footer 'CPU execution resumes when I/O completes'. No durations or code body.
